purpose: Headless desktop regression and installed alpha-candidate package integration evidence for four reviewed native spelling aliases; no registry publication, language accuracy, performance or physical-device certification.

source.identity: Modified checkout identified by runtime, declarations, tests, config, demo and package-verification source hashes. Core changes are only the four lexicon aliases; later documentation-only edits do not change these runtime or test identities.
source.documentationScope: README.md and examples/README.md are intentionally excluded from checkout fileSha256. The installed candidate tarball checksum identifies the README at packaging time; it is not asserted to equal a later checkout README after benchmark-summary updates.

packageCandidate.name: sahajlipi
packageCandidate.publicationStatus: These local checks do not establish npm registry publication or availability.

packageConsumer.method: npm pack and offline installation in a standalone temporary ESM app; browser examples compiled and bundled through installed public exports.
checks: JavaScript public imports and blocked internal exports pass the runtime verification consumer
Strict TypeScript 5.9.3 NodeNext core without DOM declarations
Strict NodeNext and Bundler DOM consumers and tutorial files
Emitted TypeScript core tutorial executes in Node with the documented output
esbuild input validation requires installed SahajLipi and rejects checkout src imports
Installed vanilla and React consumers pass all nine browser runs (three scenarios in each desktop engine)
packageConsumer.dependencies: No runtime, peer or optional package dependencies; React and tooling are development dependencies.
packageConsumer.tarballScope: Checksum is the actual generated consumer manifest checksum and agrees with the successful root npm run verify:package run. The temporary installed tarball is cleaned up by the tools; later checkout documentation edits are not assigned this checksum.

rawReport.retention: Generated reports ignored; CI artifacts retained for 14 days.

nodeTests.evidenceScope: Successful root full-run summary; the browser JSON measures browser tests only.

packageVerification.evidenceScope: Successful root runtime/TypeScript consumer verification; local tarball installation is not npm publication evidence.

scenarios: Live conversion of all four reviewed aliases with danda
Roman source remains editable through deletion and retyping; undo returns the partial spelling and redo restores the preferred native word
English mode preserves later native alias input literally
nativeSpellingCoverage.runtimeScope: Only src/lexicon.js changes from cbcd77. All prior core, phonetic, loanword, text-policy, DOM adapter and declaration source files retain baseline bytes.

limitations: Headless desktop engines only; no installed application or physical device certification.
React 19.3.0 uncontrolled textarea recipe only; no controlled-value, form-library, SSR/hydration or all-framework support claim.
Existing clipboard, composition and native-input fallback tests inject events; no OS clipboard, real IME or mobile keyboard certification.
Counts describe selected software checks. Source-assisted spelling references are development labels; neither independent human verification nor held-out linguistic accuracy is established.
The alpha candidate is tested from a local npm tarball. These checks do not establish that it has been published, has a registry dist-tag or is available for npm installation from the registry.

Runtime/test/config/demo/declaration hashes and the measured package-consumer tarball checksum identify this run. Later documentation changes can change a subsequent tarball without changing the measured runtime or tests.
